items.source: In that case, there will be no need to invoke TargetSource.releaseTarget(Object), and the AOP framework can cache the return value of TargetSource.getTarget().
items.translation: 在这种情况下，无需调用TargetSource.releaseTarget(Object)，AOP 框架可以缓存TargetSource.getTarget()的返回值。

items.source: Alternatively, use a JndiObjectFactoryBean with a "proxyInterface". "lookupOnStartup" and "cache" can then be specified on the JndiObjectFactoryBean, creating a JndiObjectTargetSource underneath (instead of defining separate ProxyFactoryBean and JndiObjectTargetSource beans).
items.translation: 或者，使用带有 "proxyInterface" 的 JndiObjectFactoryBean。 此时可以在 JndiObjectFactoryBean 上指定 "lookupOnStartup" 和 "cache"，从而在下方创建一个 JndiObjectTargetSource（而不是定义单独的 ProxyFactoryBean 和 JndiObjectTargetSource 组件）。

items.source: Can be used as alternative to JndiObjectFactoryBean, to allow for relocating a JNDI object lazily or for each operation (see "lookupOnStartup" and "cache" properties). This is particularly useful during development, as it allows for hot restarting of the JNDI server (for example, a remote JMS server).
items.translation: 可用作 `JndiObjectFactoryBean` 的替代方案，以支持延迟或针对每个操作重新定位 JNDI 对象（请参阅 "lookupOnStartup" 和 "cache" 属性）。这在开发过程中特别有用，因为它允许热重启 JNDI 服务器（例如远程 JMS 服务器）。
